confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live booking pages or current menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than July accommodation anchors, which are peak-season and more uncertain. Cocktail and wine are set from the local beer relationship. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Romanian mid-sized university and tourism cities such as Timisoara, Iasi, Brasov and Sibiu, adjusted for Cluj-Napoca's tech-sector and student demand. Accommodation anchors reflect July peak-season pricing including taxes.
